h01-apartment.observed_description: A plain five-storey apartment building with rows of identical windows and small balconies with plants, and a glass entrance door at street level, seen from the street. No people, cars or writing.
h01-apartment.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Clearly a building of many homes, not a single house.

h02-garden.observed_description: A small private back garden: a green lawn, beds of colorful flowers along a wooden fence, one small tree and a stone path, with the house wall and an open back door at the edges. No people or animals.
h02-garden.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The fence and house wall make it a home garden, not a park.

h03-floor.observed_description: An empty room seen at a low angle: a wide floor of light wooden boards fills the photo, with a strip of white wall and baseboard at the top. No furniture or objects.
h03-floor.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the subject stays whole inside the crop. The floor fills the frame, so any crop still shows the floor.

h04-wall.observed_description: A red-brick wall fills the whole photo, with a strip of gray pavement along the bottom. No door, window, plants or people.
h04-wall.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the subject stays whole inside the crop. The wall fills the frame.

h05-stairs.observed_description: A straight indoor wooden staircase with a wooden handrail goes up between plain white walls, seen from the foot of the stairs. The steps are empty.
h05-stairs.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the subject stays whole inside the crop.

h06-roof.observed_description: The red-tiled pitched roof of a house with one brick chimney against a plain blue sky; only the top strip of the pale wall shows below. Nothing is on the roof.
h06-roof.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The roof is the subject.

h07-toilet.observed_description: A clean white toilet with its lid closed stands against white tiles on a tiled floor, with a toilet-paper roll on the wall and the edge of a sink at the left. No people or labels.
h07-toilet.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the subject stays whole inside the crop.

h08-key.observed_description: One silver house key on a plain metal ring lies alone on a light-gray surface, seen from above. Nothing else in the photo.
h08-key.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the subject stays whole inside the crop.

h09-key-floor.observed_description: One silver key on a ring lies on a floor of light wooden boards in an empty room, with a strip of white wall and baseboard at the top. Nothing else on the floor.
h09-key-floor.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The key is clearly a key and clearly on the floor.

h10-key-table.observed_description: One silver key on a ring lies in the middle of the top of a small plain wooden table that stands on a wooden floor in front of a white wall; the floor under the table is empty.
h10-key-table.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The key is clearly on the table.

h11-cat-roof.observed_description: A gray tabby cat with a white chest and a blue collar sits on the red tiles of a pitched house roof near its edge, against a plain blue sky. One cat; no people.
h11-cat-roof.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The cat is small but sharp and clearly on the roof.

h12-cat-stairs.observed_description: A gray tabby cat with a white chest and a blue collar sits on a middle step of a straight indoor wooden staircase with white walls, looking at the camera; empty steps below and above.

h13-dog-garden.observed_description: A golden-tan dog with a red collar stands on the lawn of a small back garden with flower beds, a wooden fence and a tree; a corner of the house is at the left edge. One dog; no people.
